#  13022 - Selected Topics in Statistical Physics Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13022 - module is no longer offered from WS 2021/22**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Selected Topics in Statistical Physics**  |  
|  Ausgewählte Kapitel der Statistischen Physik   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. Bestehorn, Michael 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | After successfully completing the module, students have a good grasp of the description of phase transitions in lattice models, including determination of critical indexes by means of the Wilson renormalization group and elements of non-equilibrium statistics as well as stochastic differential equation with simplest applications.They are able to familiarize themselves with technical topics independently.Additionally, students can apply their presentation skills and further competences as accurateness, endurance and curiosity purposefully.  |  
| Contents:  | The following topics in statistical physics may serve as examples to demonstrate the methods of attaining new perceptions: 
  * Scale invariance in physics
  * Phase transitions
  * Critical indexes, renormalization group
  * Stochastic differential equation, Brownian motion
  * Nonequilibrium statistical mechanics, linear response, Kubo-formula

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Knowledge of theoretical physics from bachelor studies e.g. knowledge of the content of modules
  * 11874: Theoretische Physik G1 (Mechanik, Quantenmechanik)
  * 11875: Theoretische Physik G2 (Elektro- und Thermodynamik)
  * 11876: Theoretische Physik V1 (Mechanik, Quantenmechanik)
  * 11877: Theoretische Physik V2 (Elektro- und Thermodynamik)

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 150 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * W. Nolting, Grundkurs Theoretische Physik Band 6: Statistische Physik
  * F. Schwabl, Statistische Mechanik
  * A. Lindner, Grundkurs Theoretische Physik

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Oral examination, 30-45 min.

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme Physics M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Physical Specialization with Theoretical Focus“, topic area „Theory, Simulation and further topics“

Self organised studies are composed of: 
  * reworking of the lecture
  * treatment of exercises

 |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Lecture: Selected Topics in Statistical Physics 
  * Related examination

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
